## Checklist

- [ ] Failing test first, then the code (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `pytest` pass locally
- [ ] Judgment parameters carry `calibrated: false` and a rationale
- [ ] No expected return or average across scenarios is reported anywhere
- [ ] English only, no em dashes, no absolute paths or private references
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated for user-visible changes
